title.en: FSCA Update for Maquet Cardiohelp II Base Unit (Model 701077135) – Change in Corrective Actions
title.zh: Maquet Cardiohelp II 基础单元 FSCA 更新：更正措施变更

summary.en: Swissmedic has published a Field Safety Corrective Action (FSCA) for Maquet Cardiopulmonary GmbH's Cardiohelp II Base Unit, a roller-type cardiopulmonary bypass system. title.en: Follow-up Field Safety Notice for ORBIS Medication 3.x by DH Healthcare GmbH

title.en: Zimmer Tourniquet Systems: Field Safety Corrective Action for Serial Number Update (Models 60500010100, 60320010100)

summary.en: Zimmer Surgical, Inc. has issued a Field Safety Corrective Action (FSCA) for the Zimmer Tourniquet Systems concerning models 60500010100 and 60320010100. title.en: Zimmer Tourniquet Systems Serial Number Update – Swissmedic FSCA
title.zh: Zimmer 止血带系统序列号更新 – Swissmedic FSCA

title.en: Swissmedic FSCA: Newport HT70 Ventilator (Covidien) – Additional Devices Affected

title.zh: Swissmedic FSCA：Covidien Newport HT70 Plus呼吸机新增受影响设备
